mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% and federal funds rate remains below 0.1%, high inflation without policy response causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8%) with accelerating job losses (mo-mo UNRATE increase > 0.1%) signals economic distress, prompting Fed rate cuts that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening consumer demand, improving growth prospects and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances with positive HOUST change, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 (INDPRO < 95) signals weakening economic activity, increasing recession fears and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 900 (HOUST < 900) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) signals housing market distress without policy response, prompting Fed rate cuts that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: housing market distress with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) signals persistent inflation without policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
